fields.label: DATE
fields.reference: Enter the date of the fax (e.g., January 11, 1999)

fields.label: CLIENT NO.
fields.reference: Enter the client number (e.g., L8557.002)

fields.label: MESSAGE TO
fields.reference: Enter the name of the recipient (e.g., Dewey Tedder)

fields.label: COMPANY
fields.reference: Enter the company name (e.g., Lorillard Tobacco Company)

fields.label: FAX NUMBER
fields.reference: Enter the fax number (e.g., 336/373-6917)

fields.label: PHONE
fields.reference: Enter the phone number (e.g., 336/373-6750)

fields.label: FROM
fields.reference: Enter the sender's name(s) (e.g., Andy Zausner and Rob Mangas)

fields.label: PAGES (including Cover Sheet)
fields.reference: Enter the total number of pages (e.g., 2)

fields.label: HARD COPY TO FOLLOW
fields.reference: Indicate if a hard copy will follow (YES or NO)

fields.label: MESSAGE
fields.reference: Enter the message content (e.g., The following is for your review.)
